verses.text: <pb/><t>A cikin fid da zuciyata,</t> <t>Na yi kira gare ka, ya Ubangiji.</t>
<t>Ka ji kukana, ya Ubangiji,</t> <t>Ka kasa kunne ga kiran da nake yi na neman taimako!</t>
<t>Idan kana yin lissafin zunubanmu,</t> <t>Wa zai kuɓuta daga hukunci?</t>
<t>Amma kakan gafarta mana,</t> <t>Domin mu zama masu tsoronka. <pb/></t>
<t>Na zaƙu, ina jiran taimako daga Ubangiji,</t> <t>Ga maganarsa na dogara.</t>
<t>Ina jiran Ubangiji,</t> <t>Na zaƙu ƙwarai, fiye da matsara waɗanda suke jiran ketowar alfijir,</t> <t>I, fiye da matsara waɗanda suke jiran ketowar alfijir. <pb/></t>
<t>Ya Isra'ila, ki dogara ga Ubangiji,</t> <t>Saboda ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce,</t> <t>A koyaushe yana da nufin yin gafara.</t>
